title: Prospective Phase II study on Safety and Efficacy of Fludarabine plus Treosulfan (14g) (FT14) conditioning regimen for allogeneic Stem Cell Transplantation (allo-SCT) in Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) patients (≥40 <65years)
official: Prospective Phase II study on Safety and Efficacy of Fludarabine plus Treosulfan (14g) (FT14) conditioning regimen for allogeneic Stem Cell Transplantation (allo-SCT) in Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) patients (≥40 <65years)
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the safety and efficacy of the FT14 conditioning regimen for allo-SCT in AML patients (≥40 <65years) in complete morphological remission (CR/CRi/MLFS)

interventions.name: Treosulfan Tillomed 5g polvere per soluzione per infusione
FLUDARABINE TEVA 25 mg/ml, solution à diluer pour injectable ou perfusion
Grafalon 20 mg/ml concentrato per soluzione per infusione

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients >40 <65 years of age
2. Diagnosis of AML in first CR/CRi/ MLFS
3. Eligible for allo-SCT from HLA-identical matched related or unrelated donor as defined by molecular high-resolution typing (4 digits) at the following four HLA gene loci (HLA-A, B, C, and DRB1)
4. Adequate hepatic function (bilirubin ≤2 UNL; ALT/AST ≤2,5 UNL)
5. Adequate renal function (creatinine clearance ≥50 ml/min)
6. ECOG Performance Status < 2
7. Willing and able to comply with all of the requirements and visits in the protocol
8. Written and signed informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. AML patients with t(15;17); t(8;21); inv(16)
2. Participation in another clinical trial within 1 month before the start of this trial
3. Participant, both female and male, in childbearing age who do not agree to maintain active contraceptive practice
4. Pregnant or lacting patients during screening
5. Subject has known active CNS involvement with AML
6. Grade >2 NCI-CTCAE (v. 5) adverse events at the time of enrollment
7. Serious organ dysfunction: left ventricular ejection fraction < 40%, FEV1, FVC, DLCO (diffusion capacity) <40% of predicted, LFT > 5 times the upper limit of normal, or creatinine clearance < 40 ml/min
8. The evidence of HBV or HCV active infection (HBV DNA, HCV RNA positive test)
9. Patients with HIV infection
10. Current uncontrolled infections
11. Patients with other life-threatening concurrent disease
12. Subjects with known hypersensitivity to any of the component medication
